correctness.rationale: The frozen 93-tetrahedron table yields f=(16,109,186,93), ranks of boundary maps d2=93 and d3=92 over F2, hence H2 dimension 186-93-92=1. The full enumeration of every vertex subset of sizes 1 through 9 gives carrier counts 0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,37. For each of all 37 nine-vertex carriers, independently replayed elementary free-face collapses preserving vertices yield a connected surface with f=(9,30,20), link cycles at every vertex, and Euler characteristic -1; by classification it is nonorientable genus 3. Every final 20-triangle fundamental mod-two cycle maps to the nonzero ambient H2 class; four carriers were already surfaces. Independently reconstructed finite program from actual Git verify.py facet table, not verifier log; exhaustive bounded support search and certificates do not imply anything about larger supports or integral H2.
